title: Dark game-store dashboard with a breakout featured card (Steam redesign)
contains_third_party_content: Steam name and logo; game art and titles (Ghost of Tsushima, F1 22, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare, FIFA 22, GTA V, Death Stranding); platform icons; portraits.

observed.layout: Near-black window on a blue-grey backdrop. Left sidebar: logo, Home, Store (active, blue left bar, expanded with Featured highlighted, Categories, Discover, Wishlist), Library, Friends, Community, Settings pinned at the bottom. Top: search, mail icon, user with dropdown. Main: a featured card with game art pops out of the grid (shadow, overlap, platform icons, a '+ 45 Friends' strip) and covers the left edge of the info panel, so the text reads 'host of Tsushima' and 'ucker Punch Productions'; then tags (Role playing, Action, Shooter) and a blue '$69.99 Purchase' button. Rows: 'Most Popular' (F1 22 and Call of Duty with category tags) with a FIFA 22 card floating over the end; 'Wishlist' (GTA V, Death Stranding); 'Friends' (Playing GTA V with a 'Join the game' link; 'Last played 2 hours ago').
observed.hierarchy: Featured card first, then the rows.
observed.typography: Neutral sans; small grey tags and labels. Typeface unconfirmed.
observed.iconography: Outline sidebar icons; platform icons on the featured art.
observed.materials: Dark panels, shadowed breakout cards over the grid.

implementation_notes: Breakout cards use overlap and z-index with a shadow.
Sidebar shows the active section and its sub-pages.

concept_work.essence: A neutral dark shell lets varied key art sit side by side; one feature breaks the grid for emphasis.
what_makes_it_work: One blue for current section, tags and the buy action.
Breakout cards add depth and a sense of 'featured'.
The sidebar shows both the active section and its sub-pages.
gaps_to_make_it_work: The overlap clips the title and developer text.
'Shooter' as a tag for Ghost of Tsushima is questionable content.
Active 'Store' label measures about 2.61-2.87:1 and inactive items about 4.16-4.75:1.
The floating FIFA card hides part of its neighbor.

links: Blue marks the active nav item and the primary buy action.
Friends activity links to library titles.

pattern.name: Dark store shell with a breakout feature
avoid_when: The breakout would cover text or controls
must_preserve: Uniform card sizes except one feature
free_to_vary: how far the feature breaks the grid
adaptation_examples: Streaming store: featured movie breaks the grid.
App store: featured app card over the shelf.

lessons: Let a breakout overlap only decorative regions, never text.
Check tag accuracy against the content.

measured.palette_method: Median-cut quantization of the supplied image plus saturated-pixel hue medians. Approximate (JPEG). Items marked 'approx' were judged by eye.
measured.color_roles: A neutral dark stack; game art supplies the color; blue is the only UI color.
measured.contrast_method: Estimated from compressed images. Background = dominant color in a box around the text. ratio_low = conservative estimate (mean of the most distant ~4% of pixels). ratio = best estimate (mean of the most distant ~1.5% of pixels; for text on a saturated background that appears near-white or near-black, the text is assumed pure white or black, because anti-aliasing of small text otherwise understates the contrast). Accessibility scores use ratio_low; critical failure CF1 uses ratio. Gradient or photo backgrounds are measured one text line at a time. Values within 0.4 of a threshold are borderline and should be verified in the source file.

evidence: A game store whose structure and primary action are clear.
Strong, art-led dark composition with a single accent.
Store conventions are followed, but the overlap clips the title and developer and a tag is questionable.
Active nav and purchase are clear; the overlap hides content; no hover states.
Cards, radii and the single blue are consistent.
A breakout featured card is a distinctive emphasis device.
Scored on conservative values: primary text min 2.61:1; secondary text min 2.76:1; icon min n/a:1; non-color state cue: True.
accessibility.basis: computed from measured contrast + cue flag (scope: contrast and non-color cues only; touch targets, motion and screen-reader support cannot be assessed from a static image)

critical_failures.description: A primary text/label measures below 3:1 contrast (best estimate)

evaluation.readiness_key: A = ship with minor adjustments (>=80, no critical failure); B = needs specific fixes (60-79); C = rethink (<60)
evaluation.scope: Scored as presented in a static image. States, motion and behavior that are not shown are not scored as present.
